summary: Preserve step progress and completion notes across mission revisions

replay.detail: No replay or backfill is required. Summary reads follow existing step-run.carried links, including revisions written by older builds.

schema.detail: No database, generated client schema, public command or claim field changes. The reader uses existing carry references and work claims.

rules.detail: No checkpoint retention rule, digest or version changes. Revision compatibility, authority and attempt boundaries remain in force.

compatibility.detail: Carried steps expose their prior progress timestamps and completion summaries through the revision cutover. Successor reports supersede inherited notes; a new attempt starts without them. Existing work action eligibility, live-lease requirements and terminal-step refusals are unchanged. Older servers keep their previous summary behavior.

downtime.detail: The server change needs the usual daemon upgrade/restart. Upgrade interruption has not been measured.

manual.detail: No operator repair or repeated note entry is needed for steps with existing carry links. Changed steps and new attempts do not inherit incompatible progress.

recovery.detail: Rollback needs no data migration. Existing claims remain readable; an older server again omits carried summaries.
